summary: Query interface for the notebook at a specific file-or-symbol address. The `kbLookup` function returns everything anchored there: file notes (facets, features, character), flow notes with their step positions, and lessons—all with live freshness stamps. Flow note anchors are derived at query time from flow steps, so backlinks never go stale. Flow notes bridge files the code graph cannot connect (same tmpdir, hand-typed names, convention-only links), operationalizing the design rule that notebook is the source of truth for runtime/data/convention-only edges.
